scripts.dev: powershell -NoProfile -Command "concurrently -n web,agent -c cyan,green 'npm run dev:web' 'npm run dev:agent'"
scripts.test: powershell -NoProfile -Command "python -m pytest tests/smoke/test_repo_layout.py -v; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm run test:agent; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm run test:web; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
